CommonOperationStrategy is built only by the two bundled engine builders; an engine profile's `strategy` is non-derivable (absent from DERIVABLE_ENGINE_PROFILE_KEYS) and its opaque bundled `assembly` closes over it, so no external consumer can author or replace this type.

Intentional breaking change: SubgraphResult is keyed by (kind, id) instead of node id, so two same-id nodes of different kinds can both be returned. The id-keyed nodes/adjacency/reverseAdjacency maps are replaced by plain nodes and edges arrays, with (kind, id) lookups in the indexSubgraph() helper. SubgraphResult is produced by TypeGraph, not authored by consumers; listed under Breaking in the changeset.

RecordedStoreViewImplementation is a nominal class with private fields and inherited protected store/coordinate state. Consumers construct views through the exported constructor or Store, or subclass and inherit this method; they cannot structurally author an implementation. Adding the method preserves those construction paths. The internal StoreRuntime port remains optional and a missing reader is refused with a typed error.

Defaulting a missing relation to a shared table would violate working-copy isolation. Partial constructor overrides remain supported; custom connectors and complete maps must include recordedAnchors, as documented in the changeset.

This preserves the ownerless version-1 inspection grammar; it does not introduce a new wire requirement. Version-1 application is intentionally refused as documented in .changeset/origin-bound-recorded-anchors.md.
